text:
arjun: Heads up — overnight nightly eval ran on the deploy candidate (rwdw-3b-edge, int6 quant profile). Seeing a concentrated failure mode: instruct-heavy suite pass rate dropped ~18% vs baseline, lots of short-answer prompts returning blank or just punctuation. :rotating_light:
maria: Oof. Can you paste the top-level numbers? which cohorts are worst?
arjun: Quick summary from the run: baseline pass_rate=69.4% -> candidate=51.2% (delta -18.2). Fail_count=42. Majority from: legal-cohort (17 fails), short-answer-cohort (14), conversational-fewshot (6), misc prompts (5).
infra-bot: nightly-run: job_id=2026-03-20-02:00:00, model=rwdw-3b-edge:int6, shards=6, duration=18m, failed_tests=42, rerun_link=https://ci.redwood/test/2026-03-20-02.
sylvia: Sample outputs attached (copied). Looks like the model often truncates mid-answer or emits only punctuation for short-answer prompts. Not typical hallucination — it's empty-ish generation. Example:
```\nPROMPT: "What is the statute of limitations for X in state Y?"\nEXPECTED: "The statute of limitations is 3 years for..."\nCANDIDATE: "..."\nBASELINE: "3 years for most civil claims in Y; exceptions apply..."\n```
leo: Could be tokenization/offset shift from the int6 quant codepath. Also possible kv-cache padding bug when sequence length auto-batched. Have we seen anything similar on previous int6 test runs?
maria: I scanned past two weeks — int6 runs had small regressions but nothing this concentrated on legal/short-answer. int4 earlier flagged different failure classes (coherence), not blank outputs.
sylvia: Another hypothesis: compiler kernel selection for small sequence lengths might be returning EOS earlier when using the int6 kernels. That would look like empty outputs.
arjun: Initial severity P2. Assigning owners for triage: @nina to run quick repros, @leo to validate kernel selection logs, @sylvia to check tokenization diff between baseline/build. If this looks like a deploy risk we may pin candidate back to fp16 for hosted.
nina: I can run repros now. Plan: (1) re-run failing subsets with --seeded --no-stream --no-kvcache on same candidate, (2) re-run same set on float32 baseline replica, (3) capture logits+eos probabilities for first 30 tokens. Will report in ~45m. :eyes:
leo: I'll pull the compiler logs and kernel selection traces for job_id 2026-03-20-02. Also will compare kernel choices between int6 and fp16 for sequences <64.
sylvia: I'll diff the tokenizer offsets for the failing prompts vs baseline (token lengths, special token insertion). If we see off-by-one there that's a smoking gun.
infra-bot: scheduled-rerun: job 2026-03-20-02 -> rerun_id=2026-03-20-02a queued, ETA ~10m. Link: https://ci.redwood/test/2026-03-20-02a
maria: If nina confirms reproducible on candidate but not on baseline, we should block rollout and open a critical bug (owner: eng-runtime). If non-reproducible, we still want a deeper nightly variance ticket.
arjun: Agreed. Also add quick check: run the same subset with batch_size=1 and batch_size=8 to check batching effect. Nina, can you add that to your run matrix?
nina: Yep — will include batch sizes 1/4/8, with and without kvcache. Posting results in thread when done.
maria: Thanks — assigning follow-up: create GH issue with labels [regression][nightly][int6] and link this thread. Whoever owns the issue should ping infra on-call if rollout window is within 24h.
leo: Quick note — if it is kernel selection we might see different behavior only on GPU type A100-40GB vs A100-80GB due to microkernel thresholds. I'll include host flavor in logs.
sylvia: Also check decoding params: do we have any per-model default change in temperature/top_p for the candidate? Small param drift can exacerbate short outputs.
arjun: Good point. I confirm no intentional param changes but will verify deploy config.
infra-bot: audit-log: deploy-candidate rwdw-3b-edge:int6 -> scheduled 2026-03-21; pending triage result.
maria: Ok team — initial triage complete. Severity P2, owner @nina, secondary owners @leo,@sylvia. If nina repros and failure persists, escalate to eng-runtime and hold the deploy.
arjun: Thanks. Posting a quick checklist in case we need to rollback: 1) Pin model to last-known-good fp16 profile, 2) Pause canary, 3) Notify customers on Dedicated impacted regions (EU1), 4) Run extended evals overnight.
nina: Starting runs now. Will update thread.
infra-bot: rerun-started: rerun_id=2026-03-20-02a, queued_on=infra-queue-3
